answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by requiring each identity to post a stake and then prove ongoing, distinct reasoning work. Reputation is not static: it decays unless continuously renewed, so a grove of throwaway accounts collapses under the cost of keeping each one alive. When a sybil tries to ride a plume of hype, honest peers refuse to attest its work, and its reputation drains away like a sable shadow at dawn.
